title: Toward functional oversight of neural organoid research: A report from the 2025 Asilomar Conference
title_zh: 迈向神经类器官研究的功能性监督：2025年阿西洛马会议报告
abstract: In November 2025, an international multistakeholder group convened at Asilomar, California, to address oversight of rapidly advancing neural organoid and assembloid research. This process report documents the convening's design, outcomes, and lessons, and it asks what it will take to turn this momentum into ongoing monitoring and practical guidelines that ensure responsible research without constraining scientific progress.
abstract_zh: 2025年11月，一个国际多利益相关方群体在加利福尼亚州阿西洛马聚会，以应对快速发展的神经类器官和组织体研究的监督问题。本过程报告记录了该次会议的设计、成果与经验，并探讨如何将这一势头转化为持续监测与实用指南，从而在不限制科学进步的前提下确保负责任的研究。
